Keyed `<file>::<rule>` and COUNTED, not line-numbered, so unrelated edits do not churn it, and
fixing one rule in a file cannot pay for introducing another. TWO-SIDED and SHRINK-ONLY: a count
above its entry is a NEW violation and fails; a count BELOW it is a STALE entry and ALSO fails,
because a number left high after a fix re-admits the defect for free. Fix a site and LOWER its
entry in the same commit. Never raise one. There is no amnesty mechanism, deliberately.
